scope: User-authorized read-only PID-scoped CPU/RAM measurement, no concurrent tests/app builds or runtime mutation

method.cpuBasis: 100 percent is one logical core; machine percentage divides by logical processor count
method.workingSetCaveat: Summed working sets may double-count shared pages
method.membershipCaveat: May miss short-lived descendants between scoped tree refreshes
method.aggregation: CPU deltas and memory sums derived directly from serialized per-process fields; PowerShell dictionary Measure-Object aggregates were corrected before analysis
